CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  April 17, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Tsujii, Garcia, Wang

  Absent:  Gardea, Grijalva, Mojarro, Pham

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Maia
  McCurley, Senior Planner; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Wang

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – APRIL 3, 2023 (7:03 P.M.)
  x Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the April 3, 2023, Regular Meeting of the Alhambra
  Planning Commission.
  x Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the April 3, 2023, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  x  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  x  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  x  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Tsujii, Garcia, Wang
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Gardea, Grijalva, Mojarro, Pham

  x  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  PRESENTATION SERIES ON THE COMPREHENSIVE ZONING
  CODE UPDATE (7:04 P.M.)
  x This is the seventh continuation of the eighth presentation in a series
  of presentations on the Comprehensive Zoning Code Update project
  presented by Planning Division Staff.
  x Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report and provide
  input to Staff as deemed appropriate.
  x The public comment portion of the Discussion Item was opened
  and closed.
  x Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Bert Ng
  3.) Lewis McCammon
  4.) Melissa Michelson
  5.) Antonio Gardea
  x Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  x Motion on Comment #39:
  o Moved to have Staff complete additional research on
  development standards for green space and definitions of green
  space, and then provide this information to the Commission at the
  next regular Planning Commission meeting.
  o Moved by Commissioner Tsujii, Seconded by Commissioner
  Olson.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
  x Motion on Comment #40:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Tsujii.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
  x Motion on Comment #41:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
  2
  04/17/2023
   x  Motion on Comment #42:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Tsujii, Seconded by Vice President
  Garcia.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
  x  Recess at 8:42 P.M.
  x  Reconvene at 8:48 P.M.

  x  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:

  Audio:
  https://www.cityofalhambra.org/DocumentCenter/View/4314/PC-Meeting---April-
  17-2023

  Video:
  https://www.cityofalhambra.org/DocumentCenter/View/4323/PC-Meeting---April-
  17-2023-Video-MP4

F.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  x  Jennifer Ng discussed the need to provide adequate parking facilities for commercial
  uses. (9:59 P.M.)

  x  Lewis McCammon commented on the proposed development standards for allowing
  affordable housing on religious facility sites; the definition for workforce housing and
  the affordability levels associated with workforce housing; the noticing process for the
  upcoming public hearings for the Zoning Code Update; and the re-designation of P
  (Parking) zone lots adjacent to lots with residential improvements. (10:01 P.M.)

  x  Ari Gutierrez Arambula commented on the re-designation of P (Parking) zone lots
  with residential improvements; common open space trends in new developments; the
  noticing process for the upcoming public hearings for the Zoning Code Update; and
  the facilitation of the development of an “Old Town” through the Zoning Code Update.
  (10:07 P.M.)

  x  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:

  Audio:
  https://www.cityofalhambra.org/DocumentCenter/View/4314/PC-Meeting---April-
  17-2023

  Video:
  https://www.cityofalhambra.org/DocumentCenter/View/4323/PC-Meeting---April-
  17-2023-Video-MP4
  3
  04/17/2023
 G.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  x  Commissioner Ho asked for clarification on the remaining items of the Zoning Code
  Update that Staff still needs to present to the Planning Commission and potential
  changes to the Zoning Code Update timeline. (10:12 P.M.)

  x  Commissioner Olson requested Staff provide a copy of the current Zoning Map with
  the next agenda packet. (10:15 P.M.)

  x  Commissioner Tsujii thanked Staff for their work on the Zoning Code Update. (10:15
  P.M.)

  x  President Wang thanked Staff for their work on the Zoning Code Update and for the
  public’s participation in the process. President Wang requested Staff provide
  information at the next regular Planning Commission meeting on existing P (Parking)
  zoned lots that are not owned by the same commercial businesses that utilize the lots.
  President Wang also requested Staff provide information on re-designation of existing
  P (Parking) zone lots that are adjacent to lots with residential improvements. (10:16
  P.M.)

  x  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 10:19 P.M. to Monday,
